- Subprocessors: summary attached — key entries: AWS (S3, EC2, KMS) for storage/compute, GCP (bigquery) for analytics pipelines (used only for internal telemetry), Cloudflare (CDN), Datadog (observability), HashiCorp Vault (secrets for private deployments), and our model runtime partners (only for hosted model variants; note: for Dedicated/Private we do not export customer data to external model providers unless explicitly configured). Full list in the PDF.

- If acceptable, let's schedule a 30-min security session Tue/Wed next week. Logan & Rishi will join.
